00006   SUBROUTINE fitness(unfit,total_fitness)
00007     ! Purpose:
00008     !    This subroutine measures the fitness of the current simulation.
00009     !  the resulting fitness is added to the total fitness thusfar.
00010     !
00011     !! FITNESS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00012     IMPLICIT NONE
00013     LOGICAL                                                    :: unfit
00014     DOUBLE PRECISION   , INTENT(OUT)                           :: total_fitness
00015     INTEGER                                                    :: err
00016     CHARACTER(LEN=80), PARAMETER                               :: FITNESS_FILE = 'fitness_results'
00017     CHARACTER(LEN=80)                                          :: varfmt
00018     DOUBLE PRECISION                                           :: denom
00019     DOUBLE PRECISION                                           :: objective
00020     DOUBLE PRECISION                                           :: model
00021     DOUBLE PRECISION                                           :: fit
00022     DOUBLE PRECISION                                           :: part1, part2
00023 
00024 
00025     fit       = 0
00026     denom     = 2*THICK*EDGE*EDGE*1.0E20    ! volume * 1E20
00027 
00028     ! hard-ncoded expected value (objective) function
00029     objective = (4*(FLUENCE**0.8))/(1E13**0.8+FLUENCE**0.8) 
00030     model     = REAL(O3_ABUNDANCE)/denom
00031 
00032     !NB: Alternate method for calculating fitness
00033     part1 = (((objective + ABS(objective - model)) / objective)*(-100.0)) + 100.0
00034     part2 = (((LOG10(FLUENCE_TOTAL) + ABS(LOG10(FLUENCE_TOTAL/FLUENCE))) / &
00035          LOG10(FLUENCE_TOTAL))*(-100.0)) + 100.0
00036     fit = ABS(part1) + ABS(part2)
00037 
00038     IF ( ISNAN(fit) .EQV. .FALSE. ) total_fitness  = total_fitness + fit
00039 !    IF ( QUIET .EQV. .FALSE. ) THEN
00040        varfmt = "(A7,ES10.4,A5,F10.4)"
00041        WRITE (*,varfmt) 'F_obj( ', FLUENCE, ' ) = ', objective
00042        varfmt = "(A9,ES10.4,A5,F10.4)"
00043        WRITE (*,varfmt) 'F_model( ', FLUENCE, ' ) = ', model
00044        !    varfmt = "A15,F10.4)"
00045        PRINT *, 'Total fitness: ', total_fitness
00046        PRINT *, '***********************************************************************'
00047 !    END IF
00048 
00049     CALL counter()
00050 
00051     ! if current solution's total_fitness score is too big, save time and end the simulation
00052     IF (total_fitness > FITNESS_THRESHOLD) THEN
00053        unfit = .TRUE.
00054     END IF
00055 
00056     ! save results to a file
00057     !    OPEN(UNIT=201, FILE=FITNESS_FILE, ACCESS='APPEND', ACTION='WRITE', IOSTAT=err)
00058     varfmt = "(A9,ES10.4,A12,ES10.4,A10,I15)"
00059     WRITE(*,varfmt) "FITNESS=",total_fitness,"at FLUENCE=",FLUENCE,"TIME_FREQ=",TIME_FREQ
00060     OPEN(UNIT=201, FILE=FITNESS_FILE, STATUS='REPLACE', ACTION='WRITE', IOSTAT=err)
00061     IF (err .NE. 0) THEN
00062        PRINT *, "ERROR: Failed to open fitness_results file for writing"
00063        CALL EXIT()
00064     ELSE
00065        WRITE(201, *) FLUENCE, objective, model, total_fitness
00066        CLOSE(201)
00067     END IF
00068   END SUBROUTINE fitness
